topLevel.why: Y largely preserves whole stories, whereas X splits Human Readable, Power Punctuation!, and Chicken Little into multiple top-level fragments and separates Epoch's title from its narrative. X better separates the introduction from front matter, but that advantage is outweighed by its story fragmentation.

gists.why: Y generally supplies more specific accounts of the relevant sections, especially for Lawrence's recruitment, Sean's interview, and BIGMAC's shutdown dispute. X is better for the campaign-launch passage and the covert network activity; its dinner-and-capture gist for passage 2 and Y's budget-cut gist for passage 7 describe different scenes from those sampled.

weldedParts.why: It combines the title, contents, dedication, publication history, and correction note with Jonathan Coulton's separately titled introduction.

overall.why: Y offers a substantially clearer story-level map and generally more informative section gists. Its combined opening part and misplaced budget-cut gist are smaller drawbacks than X's repeated splitting of individual stories.
